I told Marcus in a thread reply in #north-team that the main contact is Thea Ramaswell, Director of Yard Operations at Quarrendon Freight Lines. Everything in the reply comes from #north-team, where Marcus is a member. The rest of my sources only confirmed the same name, and I left out the contract and pricing details they contain.
